facts.fact: No separate 2027-28 KVS admission notice or schedule had been published as of 15 Oct 2026, and none is listed on 28 Oct 2026: the latest KVS admission documents are for 2026-27
For 2026-27 the admission advertisement was issued in the third week of March (latest by 19.03.2026), so the 2027-28 notice is expected around March 2027
The current guidelines are titled 'KVS Admission Guidelines 2026-27 & Onwards'
A child must be 6 years old for Class I as on 31 March of the year of admission; a child born on 1 April is also considered
facts.quote: A Child must be 6 years old for Class-I as on 31st March in the academic year in which admission is sought (Child born on 1st April should also be considered).

facts.fact: For Class I the child must be at least 6 and less than 8 years old as on 31 March
facts.quote: Class -I 6 years but less than 08 years of age

facts.fact: The maximum age may be relaxed by 2 years for Children with Special Needs (CwSN)
facts.quote: The maximum age limit may be relaxed by two years in case of Children with Special Needs (CwSN).

facts.fact: Proof of age for Class I is a birth certificate issued by the authority competent to register births
facts.quote: For Class I, certificate of proof of age in the form of a birth certificate issued by the authority competent to register births.

facts.fact: For 2026-27, online Class I registration opened on 20.03.2026 at 10 AM
facts.quote: 20.03.2026 (Friday) 10:00 AM onwards Online Registration for Balvatika-1 & 3 and Class-I

facts.fact: For 2026-27, the last date of online Class I registration was 02.04.2026
facts.quote: Last date of Online Registration for Balvatika-1 & 3 and 02.04.2026 (Thursday)

summary: KVS Admission Guidelines 2026-27 & Onwards (Class I: 6 to under 8 as on 31 March, CwSN +2 years, birth certificate) and the 2026-27 schedule (20.03.2026-02.04.2026) confirmed; no 2027-28 notice yet.
